title: Form & Future — Your vision, our digital reality
features: Purple/pink glass hero, gradient headline and lightning badge, original animated luminous horizon artwork, looping text-wordmark cloud, studio/work panels and an accessible multi-step local 15-minute call planner with day/time/timezone selection, validation and edit flow.
limitations: Approved vanilla static adaptation replaces React/Vite, hls.js and animation/sizing libraries. Original full-width SVG motion artwork replaces the unverified HLS stream and unavailable site-relative MP4 fallback. Custom SVG paths were not supplied; original simple SVG icons are used. Plain-text brand references replace third-party logos and are disclosed as inspirations, not clients. Scheduling is a local demo, not a calendar booking, and submits no data.
